dedupe_keys.name: watneeds global crop specific green and blue water requirements

description: WATNEEDS publishes global maps of crop-specific green and blue water requirements at five-arcminute resolution. The Figshare collection has yearly products for 2000 and 2016, monthly products for five major crops, a README and calculation code. The NetCDF grids can supply agricultural demand inputs to reservoir, irrigation or drought simulations. Green water represents crop evapotranspiration met by rain, while blue water represents supplemental irrigation demand under the method's soil-water balance. These are estimated requirements, not actual withdrawals or measured farm deliveries. Cropping calendars and multiple harvest seasons can change local interpretation. All 23 individual Figshare items state CC0, even though the collection DOI registry says CC BY 4.0; the draft uses the member rights for the data. I read own metadata and article notes without downloading the large grids. The related code item is assessed separately, and no exact catalogue record was found.
